8-Bit Input & Output Port Signal Readout

At t = 0, inputs are injected at X1 [23:31, 23], X2 [32:40, 23], and Ctrl [18, 28:36]. Across t = 1..4, the 23×13×16 Green's function propagates signals to the Output port at [27:35, 41].

Why Only 40×50 Active ROI Matters

Notice how for steps t = 1, 2, 3, the outer border outside the dashed yellow 40×50 ROI box is completely static (border_2d) and at t = 4 only the 8 output port cells at [27:35, 41] are read out. In v2, the state tensor is cropped to (B, 1, 40, 50) and fused in SRAM via Pallas.
